passage.text: WORKSTATION RULES
Trained operators can run the sorting station and check the daily pass count.
However, you can't drink water at the desk or leave tools on the belt.
If you need to leave early, ask the shift lead first.

如果需要提前离开，先问一下带班组长。

stem: 阅读分拣站故障上报指南，再回答三个问题。

passage.text: FAULT REPORT GUIDE
If the machine stops moving, press the emergency stop first.
Do not pull any loose cables or try to fix the servo yourself.
Look carefully to see if the belt is stuck or if the sensor light doesn't work.
Then call the technician and tell him the exact station number.

material: 故障报告指南
如果机器停止运转，请先按下急停按钮。
不要拉拽松动的线缆，也不要自行修理伺服装置。
仔细看看传送带是否卡住，或者传感器的灯是否不亮。
然后叫技术员来，告诉他准确的工位编号。
